ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Programmatic systems can place ads automatically, but managers still decide which audiences to reach, what story to tell, and how to divide the budget.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 407,000 advertising, promotions, and marketing managers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 433,700 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 26,700 jobs and about 34,300 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $161,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace marketing managers, but it will reduce standardized execution. Programmatic and marketing automation accelerate routine campaigns and reports, shifting managers from watching standard media buys toward strategy, brand development, portfolio economics, and review. People limited to campaign execution face pressure, while strategic thinkers become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Strategic judgment: people set the direction.
Brand management: people build trust.
Creative review: people protect the brand voice.
Budget tradeoffs: people decide priorities.
Review decisions: people judge causality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range for marketing. Systems accelerate standard execution, while people remain responsible for strategy and brand management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard campaign execution can be replaced, not growth leadership. Strategic thinkers become scarcer as efficiency improves. People limited to campaign execution face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build data and strategy skills from the start of a marketing or communications career. Pure execution is shrinking in the AI era, so learn to run programs early.
Move beyond monitoring campaigns toward strategy plus brand management. Build data skills and work toward larger budgets.
Highlight campaigns and growth outcomes, and specify the product categories you have managed.
Do not evaluate candidates only on creativity. Look for portfolio-level business judgment. People who can run a full growth program deserve strong bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: Programmatic systems become widespread and standard execution shrinks.
Brand and strategy create opportunities.
People who can run full programs become more sought after.

body: Advertising, Promotions, and Marketing Managers coordinate brand and growth strategies, manage creative, media, and promotional resources, use data to achieve marketing goals, and review results.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Programmatic systems can place ads automatically, but managers still decide which audiences to reach, what story to tell, and how to divide the budget.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 程序化能自动投，但投什么人群、讲什么故事、预算怎么分，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年广告、促销与市场经理在岗约 40.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.37 万人，净增约 2.67 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代市场经理，但会压缩标准执行。程序化与营销自动化把常规投放和报表提速，经理从「盯标准投放」挪向「定策略、经营品牌、算大账、做复盘」。真正被挤掉的是只做投放执行的人，有策略脑子的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 策略判断：方向靠人定。
品牌经营：信任靠人养。
创意把关：调性靠人控。
预算权衡：取舍靠人。
复盘决策：因果靠人判。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的营销区——标准执行被系统加速，但策略与品牌还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准投放执行」动作，不是「增长指挥」的岗位。有策略脑子的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做投放执行的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 市场/传播起步多练数据和策略，AI 时代纯执行在缩，早点练操盘。
从「盯投放」升级成「定策略 + 经营品牌」，学数据，争取大预算。
突出操盘和增长结果，写清管过哪些品类。
选人别只看创意，要看会不会算大账。能操盘的人值得给高奖金。

ai_s7_trends: 程序化普及，标准执行缩。
品牌与策略带来机会。
会操盘的人更抢手。

body: 广告、促销与市场经理统筹品牌与增长策略，管理创意、媒介与促销资源，运用数据达成营销目标并复盘效果。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Appointment systems can manage queues automatically, but a barber's eyes and hands still determine how to create a symmetrical cut and capture the style a client wants.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 76,000 barbers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 79,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,200 jobs, with approximately 8,400 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $39,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace barbers, and exposure is low. Appointment and membership systems support business operations, but cutting hair, judging face shape, and building trust are highly interpersonal and difficult to replace. Barbers are shifting from simply cutting hair to design, customer management, and repeat business, making strong craftsmanship more secure.
ai_s3_list: Haircut technique: people create symmetry.
Face-shape judgment: people design the cut.
Trust relationships: people bring clients back.
On-site communication: people understand needs.
Shaving details: human touch remains essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, low, places this career in a low AI-exposure interpersonal area. Tools assist with appointments and memberships, while cutting hair and building relationships remain human work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure means limited risk. Appointment queue management faces replacement, not hands-on cutting. Demand for skilled barbers with loyal clients grows alongside men's grooming.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through barbering or hairstyling training and practice technique and face-shape analysis. AI reduces some administrative work, so develop craftsmanship early.
Advance from simply cutting hair to design and membership management. Learn face-shape analysis and business operations, then aim for shop manager or independent owner.
Emphasize repeat clients and examples of your work, specifying the styles you have handled. Shops value consistency and conversation.
When hiring, look beyond speed to steady hands. Barbers with loyal repeat clients merit higher commission rates.

ai_s7_trends: Appointments and memberships improve efficiency, reducing administrative work.
Men's grooming demand remains stable.
Skilled barbers with repeat clients are in shorter supply.

body: Barbers (Barbers) provide haircuts, shaving, and basic grooming, primarily for men and regular customers. They assess face shape and hair type, design haircuts, and use tools and membership systems to serve repeat clients as community-based personal service professionals.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Appointment systems can manage queues automatically, but a barber's eyes and hands still determine how to create a symmetrical cut and capture the style a client wants.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 预约系统能自动排位，但那颗头怎么修对称、客人想要的味道怎么拿，还是理发师的眼和手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年理发师在岗约 7.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.92 万人，净增约 0.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.84 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代理发师，且曝光很低。预约与会员系统辅助经营，但手上剪发、脸型判断和信任关系高度人际，难被替代；理发师从「纯剪」转向「设计 + 经营 + 回头客」，手艺好的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 剪发手法：对称靠人。
脸型判断：设计靠人。
信任关系：回头靠人。
现场沟通：需求靠人。
修面细节：手感靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的人际区——预约与会员被工具辅助，但剪发与关系还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光意味着风险小：被替代的是「预约排位」动作，不是「手上剪发」的岗位。手艺稳、有回头客的人，需求反而随男性 grooming 上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 美发培训打底，在校多练手法和脸型。AI 时代经营在缩，早点练手艺。
从「纯剪」升级成「做设计 + 会员」，学脸型与经营，争取当店长或开店。
突出回头客与手艺案例，写清跟过哪些风格。门店看重稳和聊。
选人别只看快，要看手稳不稳。有回头客的理发师，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 预约会员提效，经营缩。
男 grooming 需求稳。
手艺好回头客更缺。

body: 理发师（Barbers）为男性及常规客群提供剪发、修面与基础 grooming，判断脸型发质设计发型，运用工具与会员系统服务回头客，是社区里的人际服务角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 预约系统能自动排位，但那颗头怎么修对称、客人想要的味道怎么拿，还是理发师的眼和手定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can manage diagnostics and parts, but repairers still decide which lens group needs calibration and how to achieve the required precision.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,300 Camera And Photographic Equipment Repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 1,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with approximately 200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Camera And Photographic Equipment Repairers, but it will accelerate diagnostics. Digital tools speed up fault detection and parts matching, shifting repair work from finding parts toward precision calibration, professional-camera repair, and restoration of older equipment. Simple dust-cleaning work is most vulnerable. Repairers who deliver precise work on professional equipment have a more stable position.
ai_s3_list: Precision calibration: people ensure accuracy.
Professional-camera repair: people understand the structure.
Older-equipment restoration: people apply experience.
Repair judgment: people decide the right tradeoffs.
Communication advice: people understand needs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means digital systems accelerate diagnostic work while precision calibration still depends on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high occupational risk. Digital tools accelerate diagnostics and parts searches, not the precision-calibration role itself. Repairers who deliver accurate work on professional cameras become scarcer as productivity rises. Workers limited to simple dust cleaning face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Apprentices should practice optics and precision work. Simple tasks are shrinking in the AI era, so learn calibration early.
Move beyond dust cleaning into professional-camera repair + older-equipment restoration, and learn calibration.
List the camera models you have repaired and describe complex cases clearly.
Do not hire on speed alone. Look for candidates who think precisely.

ai_s7_trends: Diagnostics are becoming fully digital
Demand for professional-camera repair remains stable
Precision repairers are more sought after

body: Camera And Photographic Equipment Repairers diagnose and repair cameras, lenses, and related equipment. They coordinate work across optical, mechanical, and electronic components and use precision skills and calibration tools to restore faulty equipment to shooting condition.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can manage diagnostics and parts, but repairers still decide which lens group needs calibration and how to achieve the required precision.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能管检测与配件，但哪片镜组该校、精度怎么对，还是维修工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年摄像设备在岗约 0.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.19 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.93 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代摄像设备维修工，但会加速检测环节。数字化把故障检测、配件匹配提速，维修从「找件」挪向「精密校准、专业机修复、老设备抢救」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单清灰的，有精度能修专业机的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 精密校准：精度靠人。
专业机修复：结构靠人。
老设备抢救：经验靠人。
判断取舍：分寸靠人。
沟通建议：需求靠人懂。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——检测环节被系统加速，但精密校准还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被加速的是「检测找件」动作，不是「精密校准」的岗位。有精度、能修专业机的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做简单清灰的工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学徒多练光学与精度，AI 时代简单活在缩，早点练校准。
从「清灰」升级成「修专业机 + 老设备」，学校准。
突出修过哪些机型，写清复杂案例。
选人别只看速度，要看有没有精度脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 检测全面数字化
专业机需求稳
有精度的人更抢手

body: 摄像设备维修工主导相机与镜头等器材的诊断与维修，统筹光学、机械与电子部件，运用精密技能与校准工具，把故障设备恢复成可拍摄状态。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能管检测与配件，但哪片镜组该校、精度怎么对，还是维修工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Sensors can report jams and adjust speed automatically, but the operator still decides whether to stop the line, how to clear it, and whether the site is safe.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 29,100 operators and tenders were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 28,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,000 jobs. The occupation generates about 2,600 openings per year and had a median annual wage of about $41,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Conveyor Operators And Tenders, but it will assist monitoring. Sensors and centralized controls speed up inspections and speed adjustments, shifting operators from continuous watching toward emergency jam clearing, on-site response, and exception reporting. Routine monitoring becomes faster, while people who can act safely on the line become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Emergency jam clearing: people decide how to clear it.
On-site response: people decide whether to stop the line.
Safety judgment: people decide whether conditions are hazardous.
Exception reporting: people decide what to report.
Operating feel: people sense whether the line is running smoothly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate exposure. Automation assists monitoring, while people retain a firm role in on-site response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still carries risk. Automation replaces continuous screen watching, not the people who physically clear jams and respond to emergencies. Workers with practical ability and strong safety awareness become scarcer as automation increases. Roles limited to passive observation face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Education requirements are modest, so students should build equipment skills and earn relevant certificates. Roles limited to screen watching are shrinking in the AI era; learn incident response and basic repair early.
Move from watching the line to clearing jams and handling basic repairs. Learn centralized controls and work toward crew-leader or equipment roles.
Emphasize shift-work experience and real production-line exposure, including the equipment you have operated. Employers value steady and efficient workers.
Do not hire only for physical strength; assess reaction speed. Workers who can respond to unexpected events are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Centralized controls improve efficiency and reduce screen-watching roles.
Intelligent production lines reduce staffing.
Workers who can respond on site and understand repairs are more sought after.

body: Conveyor Operators And Tenders operate and monitor conveyor systems, control pace and flow, clear jams, handle exceptions, record operations, and request maintenance to keep materials moving continuously through production and logistics processes.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Sensors can report jams and adjust speed automatically, but the operator still decides whether to stop the line, how to clear it, and whether the site is safe.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 传感器能自动报堵、自动调速，但这下要不要停、怎么清、现场安不安全，还是操作员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作员看护员在岗约 2.91 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.81 万人，岗位净减约 0.10 万个，年均产生约 0.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代输送操作员，但会辅助监控。传感器和集中控制把巡检、调速提速，操作员从「全程盯」挪向「应急清卡、现场处置、异常上报」。真正被提速的是常规监控，能上手会处置的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 应急清卡：怎么清靠人。
现场处置：停不停靠人。
安全判断：危不危险靠人。
异常上报：报什么靠人。
手感把握：线顺不顺靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——监控被辅助，但现场处置还牢牢留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零风险：被替代的是「全程盯屏」的动作，不是「上手清卡、应急处突」的岗位。有现场力和安全意识的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会站着看的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高，在校多练设备和证书。AI 时代纯盯屏在缩，早点练处置和维修。
从「盯线」升级成「会清卡 + 懂点维修」，学集中控制，争取当班长或设备岗。
突出倒班经验和真实产线经历，写清跟过哪些设备。雇主看重稳和利索。
选人别只看力气，要看反应快不快。能处置突发的值得留用。

ai_s7_trends: 集中控制提效，盯屏缩。
智能产线减人。
会处置懂维修的更抢手。

body: 输送带操作员与看护员操作并监控输送系统，控制节拍与流量，清理卡堵、处理异常，记录运行并上报维修，保障物料在生产与物流环节的连续流转。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 传感器能自动报堵、自动调速，但这下要不要停、怎么清、现场安不安全，还是操作员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can route traces and check timing, but engineers still decide which board must withstand vehicle vibration and which component must absorb a cost constraint.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 95,900 Electronics Engineers, Except Computer were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 101,800 by 2034, a net gain of about 5,900 jobs, with about 5,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $127,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Electronics Engineers, Except Computer, but it will accelerate routine design. EDA, automated schematic checks, and AI-assisted layout speed up repetitive work. Engineers can focus on system architecture, signal-integrity judgment, cross-team coordination, and production readiness. Assistants limited to routine board layout face pressure, while people who can lead architecture and coordinate systems become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Coordination of thermal and mechanical design
ai_s3_list: System architecture: people define requirements.
Signal integrity: people judge boundaries.
Cross-team coordination: people align software and hardware.
Production control: people monitor yield.
Cost balance: people make component choices.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high exposure range for hardware design. Systems accelerate routing and checking, while people retain responsibility for architecture and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. AI replaces routine board layout and error checking, not system-architecture roles. Engineers who can shape architecture, align teams, and oversee production become scarcer as tools improve. Assistants limited to routine boards face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in electronics, communications, or electrical engineering and gain hands-on practice with EDA tools and oscilloscopes. Routine board layout is shrinking in the AI era, so develop systems and testing skills early.
Move from board layout to architecture and team leadership. Learn simulation and AI tools, then pursue responsibility for complete vehicle or product systems.
Highlight production and board-debugging experience and name the product types you supported. Employers value reliable, fast execution.
Do not screen only for layout speed. Assess whether candidates think in systems. Engineers who can coordinate architecture merit strong performance bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: EDA and AI improve efficiency, reducing routine board-layout work.
Automotive electronics and AI hardware create new demand.
Engineers with system-architecture skills are in greater demand.

body: Electronics Engineers, Except Computer lead the design of electronic systems, circuits, and equipment. They coordinate schematics, PCB design, embedded systems, and controls; use simulation and test tools; deliver production-ready designs; and support pilot production.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can route traces and check timing, but engineers still decide which board must withstand vehicle vibration and which component must absorb a cost constraint.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动布线和查时序，但哪块板要扛得住车载振动、成本卡在哪个器件上，还是工程师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工程师计算机在岗约 9.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.18 万人，净增约 0.59 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.57 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电子工程师，但会加速常规设计。EDA、原理图自动检查和 AI 辅助布局把重复工作提速，工程师从「画图画布局」挪向「系统架构、信号完整性判断、跨团队协调、把控量产」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规画板的助理，有架构能力能统筹的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: EDA 自动布线与过孔优化
ai_s3_list: 系统架构：需求靠人定。
信号完整性：边界靠人判。
跨团队协调：软硬件靠人扯。
量产把控：良率靠人盯。
成本平衡：选型靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的硬件设计区——布线与核查被系统加速，但架构与协调还留着人的位置。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI's eyes are faster than humans and can scan every product; but when it comes to difficult parts that "can't tell what's wrong", it's you who has to stop the production line and make a judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 598,000 inspectors, testers, sorters, samplers, and weighers employed in 2024, projected to reach 598,100 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 69,900 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $47,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace some quality inspectors, which is one of the jobs in the manufacturing industry that will be most directly impacted by automation. Machine vision, online inspection, and automatic sorting are replacing a large number of repeated visual inspections and tests. But the jobs will not disappear, but will transform: people are still needed for the determination of non-standard parts and complex parts, the disposal of abnormal batches and the formulation of standards. Quality inspectors who can operate testing equipment and understand data are more popular.
ai_s2_accel: AI vision learns complex defect characteristics and makes judgments more accurate
Inspection data is uploaded to the cloud in real time, and quality trends are automatically analyzed.
Automatic collection and upload of measuring tool and test equipment data
Defect root cause tracing uses AI to correlate historical batches
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate data entry and inspection reports
Machine vision online inspection replaces naked eye inspection
Automatic sorting and weighing system replaces manual sorting
Sampling decision logic is executed by the system according to standards
ai_s3_list: Comprehensive judgment of complex parts: When multiple indicators affect each other, the judgment is based on experience.
On-site capabilities for abnormal handling: stopping the production line when a batch is defective and locating the root cause requires people.
Cross-link communication: Quality communication with production lines, processes, and customers cannot be done by machines.
Flexible implementation of standards: Standards are provisions, and how they are implemented in actual products depends on people.
Review and judgment of equipment and data: If the AI ​​reports a defect, whether it is a misjudgment requires a human to confirm.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 shows that half of the tasks in this profession are regular - visual inspection, measurement, and recording, which are being efficiently taken over by machine vision and systems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But medium to high exposure does not equal high risk. It is a fact that repeated visual inspections have been replaced, but the number of "equipment + data" review posts, abnormality handling posts, and non-standard judgment posts are increasing. The real danger is those who can only use their eyes but not the equipment. Quality inspectors who understand testing technology and can read data will increase in value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose a major related to mechanics, electronics or food quality, and learn measuring tools, testing equipment and quality systems. Don’t just focus on positions like “visual inspection” that will be replaced by machine vision. It’s more stable to plan in the direction of quality engineers.

Take the initiative to learn machine vision, online inspection and data analysis, and take the quality engineer or internal auditor certificate. Upgrading from "seeing with eyes" to "judging with equipment and data" is the best way to fight against automation.

The threshold for entry into the quality inspection industry is low. You can start with production line inspections, and at the same time supplement the operation of testing equipment and reading of drawings. Write more quantifiable results such as "detection rate, interception batches, and improvement in pass rate" on your resume.

When recruiting for quality inspection, don’t just recruit people who can read. It depends on the equipment and data capabilities. Quality inspectors who can operate online inspections, read quality reports, and handle abnormal batches are more worthy of investment than those who are immersed in visual inspection.

The quality judgment of non-standard parts and small batch customized parts still relies on manual labor, and complex judgment has become a moat for quality inspectors.

招质检别只招「能看」，要看设备和数据能力。能操作在线检测、会读质量报表、能处置异常批次的质检员，比埋头目检的人更值得投入。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「机械巡检」动作，不是「风险研判」的岗位。有研判力、能推动整改的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会填表的专员。

突出资质和闭环经验，写清跟过哪些行业。企业看重稳和严。

风险研判带来机会。
有处置力的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Occupational Therapists, but it will take over documentation for assessment and records. Digital tools can generate training plans and progress dashboards, but face-to-face manual training, motivation, and functional judgment depend heavily on people. Therapists who can assess, practice alongside patients, and show empathy are more secure, while tools reduce pure form-filling work.

Video motion analysis to support assessment
Case management software that integrates records
ai_s2_auto: Digital assessment scales and automated aggregation
Remote follow-up and home practice check-ins

Manual training: people provide one-on-one guided practice.
Motivation: people engage emotions.
Plan adjustment: adapt flexibly to feedback.
Interprofessional collaboration: connect rehabilitation into a whole.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems divert documentation and recordkeeping, but people remain essential for face-to-face therapy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean moderate risk. Forms and templates are being replaced, not therapy roles. People who can assess, guide practice, and show empathy become more efficient as tools spread. Therapists who only document and avoid patient contact face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in rehabilitation therapy and complete extensive clinical placements while studying. AI is taking over documentation, so develop assessment and manual techniques early.
Advance from writing records to assessment and guided practice. Learn assistive devices and remote follow-up and develop specialty expertise.
Highlight case volume and specialty focus, specifying the populations you have served. Credentials are preferred.
When hiring, look beyond degrees to empathy and manual technique. Therapists who can independently lead training and collaborate deserve stronger performance compensation.

ai_s7_trends: As assessment and records become digital, therapists shift toward guided practice.
Wearables and motion analysis support precise rehabilitation.
Therapists skilled in assistive devices and remote follow-up are more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 162,700 physician assistants were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 195,800, a net increase of about 33,100 jobs, with about 12,000 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $133,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace physician assistants, but it will change how they work. AI and electronic systems are taking over medical record writing, test orders, and preliminary image screening, shifting assistants from documentation clerks toward clinical judgment + patient communication. Machines cannot replace history-taking, physical examinations, procedures, or trust. Assistants who use AI to improve efficiency become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted history-taking and structured medical histories
AI-assisted diagnostic suggestions and risk alerts
Widespread voice entry in smart medical record systems
Digital remote follow-up and chronic-disease management
ai_s2_auto: Digital medical record writing and order entry
Automated test requests and report return
AI-assisted preliminary screening of imaging and laboratory results
Automatic medication reminders and follow-up messages
ai_s3_list: Clinical judgment: distinguish priorities among symptoms and signs and decide on testing and treatment directions.
Tactile skill in physical examination: machines cannot provide palpation and auscultation.
Patient communication and trust: explain conditions clearly and absorb anxiety.
Skill in minor procedures: steady, careful work in suturing, puncture, and dressing changes.
Teamwork and response: people manage unexpected emergency situations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that more than half of this role's documentation is being automated. AI and systems can assist with medical records, test orders, and follow-up notes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over documentation, leaving clinical work to people. History-taking, physical examinations, procedures, and patient communication become more important. Pure data-entry roles are being reduced, while assistants who practice medicine and communicate well become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Follow a clinical medicine or physician assistant education path and prioritize internships and professional certification. Develop both medical foundations and communication instead of only memorizing textbooks.

Use AI medical records, diagnostic assistance, and follow-up tools, and actively pursue teaching and specialty education. Advance from documentation + execution to clinical judgment + patient management and earn advanced professional credentials.

A medical background is a firm requirement. Career changers need a new medicine-related degree. Prepare for a long learning curve and specify patient volume, procedure types, and case participation on your resume.

Do not assess assistants by credentials alone. Evaluate clinical reasoning and communication. Candidates who obtain clear histories, explain matters well, and collaborate with AI tools offer the rarest combination.

ai_s7_trends: As AI documentation and diagnostic assistance spread, assistants shift from data entry + execution toward clinical judgment + patient management, making information literacy fundamental.
Expansion of primary care and rising chronic-disease management needs increase demand for assistants skilled in follow-up and patient education.
Deeper specialization and multidisciplinary collaboration move assistants toward hybrid roles in specialty practice, teaching, and quality control.

In 2024, the median annual salary was ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES bracket, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace physicians, but it will accelerate recognition and documentation. Imaging and medical-record assistance speed initial screening, shifting people from reading images and writing orders toward integrated decisions, surgery, patient communication, and complex cases. Standard initial consultations face displacement, while experts who synthesize information and perform surgery become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Clinical decisions: people exercise judgment.
Surgical procedures: people provide steady hands.
Patient communication: people build trust.
Complex synthesis: people connect the evidence.
Accountability: people uphold the baseline.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate imaging and documentation, while people retain diagnosis and surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Initial screening and writing orders face replacement, not clinical decision roles. Experts who synthesize evidence and perform surgery become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong clinical foundations. Pure image reading is shrinking, so develop integrated judgment and communication early.
Advance from writing orders to decisions + surgery + communication and pursue primary-surgeon roles.
Highlight residency training and specialty outcomes. Hospitals value reliability and specialization.
When hiring, assess integrated judgment and communication, not education alone. Surgeons capable of leading operations deserve strong platforms.

ai_s7_trends: Imaging assistance is spreading, reducing initial screening.
Surgical robots are expanding.
Physicians with integrated judgment are in greater demand.

body: Physicians and surgeons diagnose disease, develop medication or surgical treatment plans, integrate history, physical examination, and test results into clinical decisions, and remain accountable for outcomes.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Image interpretation can be assisted, but physicians still decide what to do, whether to operate, and how to communicate with the patient.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 读片能辅助，但怎么定、敢不敢开、病人怎么沟通，还是医师的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年其他医师在岗约 34.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 34.93 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医师，但会加速识别与文书。影像与病历辅助把初筛提速，人从「看片写单」挪向「综合决断、手术、医患沟通、复杂病例」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准初诊的，会综合、能手术的专家更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 临床决断：判断靠人。
手术操作：手稳靠人。
医患沟通：信任靠人。
复杂综合：拼接靠人。
责任担当：底线靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——影像与文书被系统加速，但诊断与手术还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「初筛与写单」动作，不是「临床决断」的岗位。会综合、能手术的专家，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 打好临床底子，纯看片在缩，早点练综合与沟通。
从「写单」升级成「决断 + 手术 + 沟通」，争取主刀。
突出规培与专科成果，医院看重稳和专。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会综合和沟通，能主刀的骨干值得给平台。

ai_s7_trends: 影像辅助普及，初筛缩。
手术机器人渗透。
会综合的医师更抢手。

body: 医师与外科医生诊断疾病、制定药物或手术等治疗方案，综合病史查体与检查结果做临床决断，并对疗效负责。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 读片能辅助，但怎么定、敢不敢开、病人怎么沟通，还是医师的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate materials and schedule work, but machines cannot replace the trowel feel that tells whether a wall is level or a batch of mortar has the right consistency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 24,200 plasterers and stucco masons were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 25,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with about 1,900 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $56,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace plasterers and stucco masons. Plastering, leveling, and finishing are manual crafts built on tactile skill and accumulated experience, beyond AI's reach in physical work. AI can calculate materials, schedule jobs, and report labor, while spray machines assist with large surfaces, but fine finishing still requires human hands.
ai_s2_auto: Digital construction scheduling and labor reporting
ai_s3_list: Leveling judgment: control wall flatness and verticality.
Finishing feel: skill in smoothing and polishing surfaces.
Mortar preparation: on-site experience with consistency and ratios.
Internal and external corner technique: straight lines and smooth corners.
Construction adaptability: handle substrate problems and weather effects.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 makes plastering a moderately to highly exposed traditional trade. Material calculation and scheduling are digital, and spray equipment handles large surfaces, but leveling and finishing depend on tactile skill. Machines assist while people preserve precision, creating low near-term replacement risk; physical strain and the workforce gap are the main risks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not permit complacency. Move toward high-precision and decorative plaster, master fine work machines cannot replace, and use tools such as laser levels to improve efficiency. Craftsmanship plus tools stabilizes income.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For young people without an educational advantage who are willing to work hard, plastering is a practical trade. The industry is aging and lacks skilled workers, so trained craftspeople can find work. Learn from a reliable master and pursue high-precision and decorative plaster, which pays more and is scarcer than ordinary plastering.

Develop deeper technical skill: learn decorative plaster, corner work, and high-precision leveling; earn trade certificates and advance from plastering to wall expertise. Use tools such as laser levels to improve efficiency and pursue higher-value projects.

Entering construction as a plasterer has a low threshold, but understand the physical commitment. Start as an apprentice, choose the right mentor and crew, and learn the craft in two years. Emphasize endurance and willingness to learn; automotive repair or masonry experience provides an advantage.

The plastering workforce gap is severe. Retain workers through stable work supply + process training + transparent compensation. Give apprentices a clear path to qualification and train them in high-precision plaster. Stable project volume retains skilled workers better than scrambling for labor during peak season.

ai_s7_trends: Industry aging deepens, creating a clear shortage of skilled plasterers.
Large-area work becomes mechanized, while fine finishing and decorative processes remain human-led.
Craftsmanship plus tools continues raising artisan income.

body: Plasterers and stucco masons plaster building walls, ceilings, and exterior surfaces, including substrate preparation, mortar mixing, leveling, finishing, corner work, and decorative plaster. They are traditional craftspeople in building finishing.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate materials and schedule work, but machines cannot replace the trowel feel that tells whether a wall is level or a batch of mortar has the right consistency.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算料、能排期，但「这面墙平不平、这铲灰浆稠不稠」——抹子的手感，机器替不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年抹灰工灰泥泥瓦工在岗约 2.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.52 万人，净增约 0.10 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.60 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代抹灰工与灰泥泥瓦工：抹灰、找平、收面是手工工艺，靠的是手上的感觉和日积月累的经验，AI 够不着物理现场。AI 能帮的是算料、排期、报工，喷涂机等设备辅助大面作业，但精面和收工还是得靠人手。
ai_s2_accel: 机械喷涂辅助大面抹灰
工地安全 AI 监控
ai_s2_auto: 施工排期与报工数字化
ai_s3_list: 找平判断：墙面平整与垂直的把握。
收面手感：压光、收面的功夫。
灰浆调配：稠度、配比的现场经验。
阴阳角工艺：线角直、角口顺。
施工应变：基面问题与天气影响处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明抹灰工是「中高曝光」的传统手工工种：算料排期被数字化、大面作业有机喷设备，但找平和收面依赖手感，属于「机器辅助、人保精面」，短期替代风险低，风险主要在体力与行业断层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于能松劲：往高精灰泥、装饰工艺方向走，掌握机器替代不了的精细活，同时学会用激光测平仪等工具提效，手艺加工具，收入更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历不占优势、肯吃苦的孩子，学抹灰等手艺是务实选择：行业老龄化、熟练工断层，学成手艺不愁没活。建议跟靠谱师傅学艺，往高精灰泥和装饰工艺走，比普通抹灰工单价高、更稀缺。
往技术纵深走：学装饰灰泥、线角工艺、高精找平，考工种证书，从「会抹灰」升级成「墙面专家」；同时学用激光测平等工具，提高工效，多接高价值工程。
转行进工地学抹灰门槛低，但要想清楚体力投入：从学徒做起，选对师傅和工程队，两年把手艺学出来；面试对接时突出能吃苦、肯钻研，有汽修、泥瓦经验的更占优势。
抹灰工断层严重，留人靠「稳定活源 + 工艺培训 + 计酬透明」：给学徒明确出师路径，向高精灰泥方向培养；用稳定的工程量留住熟练工，比旺季现抓人强得多。

ai_s7_trends: 行业老龄化加深，熟练抹灰工断层明显。
大面作业机械化，精面与装饰工艺靠人。
手艺加工具，工匠收入持续走高。

body: 抹灰工与灰泥泥瓦工负责建筑墙面、顶棚与外墙的抹灰与灰泥施工，包括基层处理、灰浆调配、找平收面、线角施工与装饰灰泥工艺，是建筑装饰工程中的传统手工工种。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算料、能排期，但「这面墙平不平、这铲灰浆稠不稠」——抹子的手感，机器替不了。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Models can handle literature searches and preliminary assignment grading, but people still need to guide students through ethical dilemmas.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 17,100 postsecondary social work teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 17,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with approximately 1,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $76,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary social work teachers, but it will redesign teaching and research workflows. When AI handles lesson materials, literature discovery, and preliminary grading, teachers shift from repetitive work to classroom guidance, internship supervision, and professional judgment. People who educate effectively, conduct evidence-based research, and establish professional standards are truly scarce.
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of lesson materials and cases
Automated search for literature and evidence
Preliminary grading of assignments and exams
ai_s3_list: Classroom guidance: people help students internalize methods.
Internship supervision: people guide ethical dilemmas.
Thesis advising: people determine research design.
Professional judgment: people protect the field's boundaries.
Educational support: people accompany student growth.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates medium-high AI exposure in instructional support. Automation absorbs much material preparation and grading, but people retain an essential role in teaching guidance and supervision.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Repetitive instructional support gets replaced, not teaching positions. Faculty who educate effectively, conduct evidence-based research, and supervise internships become even scarcer. Those who only read from PPT slides and avoid fieldwork face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in social work or sociology and develop both research and practice while in school. The AI era rewards teaching ability and evidence-based research, not memorized theory alone.
Advance from lecturing to dual teaching and research tracks. Build funded projects and practice partnerships and pursue academic promotion rather than teaching mechanically from texts.
Highlight doctoral training and practice experience, and specify what you have published and supervised. Funded projects and fieldwork are preferred.
Do not hire based only on publication counts; assess teaching and mentorship. Faculty who supervise internships and conduct industry research deserve resources.

ai_s7_trends: Automation of instructional support and literature work shifts faculty toward guidance.
Expansion of social work programs drives faculty demand.
Combined teaching and research talent is in greater demand.

body: Postsecondary social work teachers teach practice and theory in university social work programs, supervise student internships, theses, and career development, and conduct research on social welfare, policy evaluation, and interventions. They develop both social-work talent and knowledge.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Models can handle literature searches and preliminary assignment grading, but people still need to guide students through ethical dilemmas.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 文献检索和作业初评能交给模型，但「这个学生的伦理困境该怎么导」，还得人陪。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校社会工作教师在岗约 1.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.75 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校社会工作教师，但会重做教学与研究流程。备课资料、文献挖掘、作业初评交给 AI 后，教师从「重复劳动」挪向「课堂引导、实习督导与专业判断」。真正稀缺的是能育人、能做有证据的研究、为行业立标准的人。
ai_s2_auto: 备课资料与案例的自动生成
文献与证据的自动检索
ai_s3_list: 课堂引导：方法体悟靠人带。
实习督导：伦理困境靠人导。
论文指导：研究设计靠人定。
专业判断：行业边界靠人守。
育人陪伴：学生成长靠人陪。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的教辅区——资料与批改大量被自动化，但教学引导与督导还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「重复教辅」，不是「岗位」。会育人、能做有证据研究、能导实习的教师反而更稀缺。怕的是只念PPT、不碰田野的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 社工/社会学打底，在校把研究与实务都练。AI 时代拼的是育人能力和证据研究，别只背理论。
从「讲课」升级成「教研双线」，攒课题和实务链接，争取评职称，别停留在照本宣科。
突出博士训练与实务经验，写清发过什么、带过什么。有课题和田野优先。
招人别只看论文数，要看教学与育人。能带实习、能做行业研究的教师值得给资源。

ai_s7_trends: 教辅与文献自动化，教师转向引导。
社工专业扩招带动师资需求。
教研双线复合人才更抢手。

body: 高校社会工作教师在大学社会工作专业讲授实务与理论课程，指导学生实习、论文与职业发展，同时开展社会福利、政策评估与干预研究，是社工人才与知识生产的双重培养者。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 文献检索和作业初评能交给模型，但「这个学生的伦理困境该怎么导」，还得人陪。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Adaptive signals can optimize green waves automatically, but technicians still decide whether to change a location, how to route around road occupation, and whether conditions are safe.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 7,900 traffic technicians were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 8,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 300 jobs, with about 800 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $58,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace traffic technicians, but it will assist monitoring and optimization. Traffic monitoring and signal-optimization recommendations accelerate preliminary work, shifting technicians from screen-based adjustments toward field surveys, construction coordination, emergency response, and technical-document review. Routine optimization becomes faster, while people who work on site and coordinate effectively become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Field surveys: People assess actual conditions.
Construction coordination: People determine detours.
Emergency response: People decide what to protect first.
Sign placement: People determine locations.
Document review: People verify accuracy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range. Monitoring and optimization receive assistance, but people retain responsibility for field work and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean zero risk. AI replaces screen-based optimization tasks, not field surveys, coordination, and emergency response. People with field and coordination skills will become scarcer as automation spreads. Those who only monitor screens are most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with an associate degree in transportation or civil engineering and practice data analysis and GIS while in school. Pure optimization is shrinking in the AI era, so develop field and coordination skills early.
Advance from signal adjustment to field work and road-occupation management. Learn intelligent transportation systems and work toward an engineering role.
Highlight certifications and real project experience, specifying the road networks supported. Employers value reliability and field mobility.
Do not hire based only on software proficiency. Assess field accuracy. People who coordinate effectively are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent transportation raises efficiency and reduces optimization work.
Urban renewal drives demand.
People skilled in field coordination are in greater demand.

body: Traffic technicians collect and analyze traffic-flow data, assist with signal timing and signs and markings, review construction road-occupation and detour plans, organize technical documents, and support road-network safety and efficiency.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Adaptive signals can optimize green waves automatically, but technicians still decide whether to change a location, how to route around road occupation, and whether conditions are safe.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自适应信号能自动调绿波，但这点要不要改、占道怎么绕、现场安不安全，还是技术员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年交通技术员在岗约 0.79 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.82 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.85 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代交通技术员，但会辅助监测与调优。流量监测、信号优化建议把前期提速，技术员从「盯屏调」挪向「现场踏勘、施工协调、应急与资料把关」。真正被提速的是常规调优，能下现场会协调的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场踏勘：实况如何靠人。
施工协调：怎么绕靠人。
应急处突：先保啥靠人。
标志设置：放哪靠人。
资料把关：准不准靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——监测调优被辅助，但现场与协调还牢牢留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零风险：被替代的是「盯屏调优」的动作，不是「踏勘、协调、处突」的岗位。有现场力和协调力的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会坐着看的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 交通/土木大专打底，在校多练数据和GIS。AI 时代纯调优在缩，早点练现场和协调。
从「调信号」升级成「下现场 + 管占道」，学智能交通系统，争取转工程师。
突出证书和真实项目经历，写清跟过哪些路网。雇主看重稳和能跑。
选人别只看软件熟，要看现场准不准。能协调的，值得留用。

ai_s7_trends: 智能交通提效，调优缩。
城市更新拉动需求。
会现场协调的更抢手。

body: 交通技术员采集并分析交通流量数据，协助信号配时与标志标线设置，核查施工占道与绕行方案，整理技术资料，保障路网安全与通行效率。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自适应信号能自动调绿波，但这点要不要改、占道怎么绕、现场安不安全，还是技术员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize welding parameters and automatically identify weld defects, but an operator still needs to fixture the workpiece and judge from the machine's sound whether the weld is good.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 38,900 machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to fall to 35,400, a net decline of about 3,500 jobs, with approximately 3,200 openings each year. For 2026, the median annual wage is about $47,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate welding-machine operator jobs, but it will raise their technical requirements. Systems and AI are taking over scheduling, parameter optimization, and weld inspection, while robotic arms replace simple loading. The remaining roles require programming, parameter adjustment, and troubleshooting. As automation spreads, people who can master the machines become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI optimizes welding parameters and automatically matches processes
Real-time feedback from online weld-quality monitoring
Defect data feeds back into process improvement
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of welding-parameter records and reports
Robotic arms replacing manual loading and unloading
Automated weld inspection replacing visual inspection
ai_s3_list: Experience-based parameter adjustment: even with the same material, changes in weather and temperature require fine-tuning learned through experience.
Fixturing and tooling alignment: secure clamping and accurate positioning directly affect weld quality.
On-site troubleshooting: people decide how to stop and address arc loss, weld misalignment, and material jams.
Overall weld-quality control: automated inspection flags a defect, but people decide whether it is real and whether rework is required.
Equipment-maintenance skill: cleaning welding guns and replacing contact tips determine the service life of welding equipment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means this occupation has limited desk-based work, and automation is absorbing what exists. Systems now handle scheduling, parameter records, and quality data.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Simple machine-tending roles are disappearing, but versatile operators who can program, adjust parameters, and troubleshoot are scarce. People who only watch machines and cannot use the equipment face real danger, while those who master automation become increasingly valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose a welding, mechatronics, or robotics program; vocational-school training is enough to start. Focus on robot programming and welding processes, distinguishing a basic operator from an operator who can program.

Proactively learn robot programming and parameter databases, and earn robot-operation and welding credentials. Advancing from machine tending to setup and programming is the most stable path in the age of automation.

A welding background provides the easiest transition into machine operation; add programming and automated-welding knowledge. On your résumé, specify which machine models you know, which products you have tuned, and the yields you achieved.

When hiring operators, look beyond the ability to watch machines and assess programming and parameter-adjustment skills. Employees who troubleshoot problems and optimize settings are essential to automated-line efficiency.

Automated loading and unloading reduces labor

Automatic gun cleaning and consumable-life management
Correlate defect trends with process parameters

ai_s7_trends: As welding automation and robots spread, simple machine-tending jobs continue to shrink, concentrating operator roles in programming, parameter adjustment, and troubleshooting.
AI parameter optimization and online inspection become standard, turning operators into welding decision-makers supported by data.
Versatile operators who can program, understand processes, and troubleshoot become the mainstay of automated production lines, with persistent shortages.

body: Welding, soldering, and brazing machine operators set and adjust welding-equipment parameters, fixture workpieces, operate automatic welding machines, and monitor weld quality. They are key technical operators bridging manual welders and fully automated production lines.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can optimize welding parameters and automatically identify weld defects, but an operator still needs to fixture the workpiece and judge from the machine's sound whether the weld is good.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能优化焊接参数、自动识别焊缝缺陷，但装夹工件、听机器声音判断「这刀焊得好不好」的，还得是操作工。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在岗约 3.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.54 万人，岗位净减约 0.35 万个，年均产生约 0.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让焊接机器操作工失业，但会拉高岗位的技术含量。排产、参数优化、焊缝检测这些正被系统和 AI 接管，机械手也替代了简单上料。留下的岗位要会编程、会调参、会处置异常——自动化越普及，能驾驭机器的人越值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 优化焊接参数，自动匹配工艺
焊接质量在线监测实时反馈
机器人编程软件化，示教更简单
缺陷数据回传驱动工艺改进
ai_s2_auto: 排产与工单电子化管理
焊接参数记录与报表自动生成
上料与下料机械手替代人工
焊缝自动检测替代人工目检
ai_s3_list: 参数调试的经验判断：同样材料，不同天气温度参数就要微调，这个靠积累。
装夹与工装定位：装得牢不牢、定位准不准，直接影响焊缝质量。
异常处置的现场能力：断弧、偏焊、卡料，停机处理的判断靠人。
焊缝质量的整体把关：自动检测报缺陷，是不是真缺陷、要不要返工，人来定。
设备维护的手艺：焊枪清理、导电嘴更换，保养质量决定焊机寿命。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面事务有限且正被自动化——排产、参数记录、质检数据都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。简单看机岗确实在消失，但会编程、会调参、能处理异常的复合操作工反而稀缺。真正危险的是不会用设备的「纯看机人」，能驾驭自动化的人越来越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选焊接、机电或机器人相关专业，技校体系即可起步。重点学机器人编程和焊接工艺，把「操作工」和「会编程的操作工」区别开来。
主动学机器人编程和参数数据库，考取机器人操作与焊工资质。从「看机」升级为「调机编程」，这是自动化时代最稳的升级路径。
有焊工基础转做机器操作最顺，补编程和自动焊知识。简历上多写「会哪些机型、调过什么产品、良率多少」。
招操作工别只看「能看机」，要看编程和调参能力。会处理异常、能优化参数的员工，是自动化产线效率的关键。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 连续稳定焊接、高速作业
自动清枪、耗材寿命管理
缺陷趋势、工艺参数关联

ai_s7_trends: 焊接自动化与机器人普及，简单看机岗持续收缩，操作工岗位向编程调参和异常处置集中。
AI 参数优化与在线检测成为标配，操作工变成「数据辅助下的焊接决策者」。
会编程、懂工艺、能处理异常的复合型操作工成为自动化产线的主力，缺口持续。
